Enriching Lives through Archaeology

Connecting communities to the past through research, engagement, and collaboration

Find out more Join Heneb

Welcome to Heneb: The Trust for Welsh Archaeology

In 2024, Heneb united Wales’ four regional archaeological trusts—Clwyd-Powys, Dyfed, Glamorgan-Gwent, and Gwynedd—into a single organisation dedicated to uncovering and preserving Wales’ rich archaeological heritage.

An independent charity with over 50 years of combined expertise, Heneb connects communities to the past by safeguarding historic sites, managing the Historic Environment Record (HER), and leading innovative research.

From archaeological excavations to community outreach, Heneb ensures Wales’ heritage is accessible, understood, and valued—now and for generations to come.

Find out more

Support Heneb

Heneb: The Trust for Welsh Archaeology is dedicated to the discovery, protection, and promotion of Wales’ historic environment. As an independent charity, Heneb relies on the generosity of supporters like you to continue this essential work.

Community Outreach

We connect people with Wales’ rich heritage through events, workshops, and volunteering opportunities. Heneb’s community programmes inspire public interest in archaeology and promote shared responsibility for preserving the past.

Learn more

Education

Heneb’s education initiatives provide learning opportunities for schools, universities, and the wider public. Through hands-on experiences, talks, and resources, we aim to make archaeology accessible and engaging for all.

Learn more

Fun activities

Discover the exciting world of archaeology with our fun activities designed for school children! From puzzles and games to hands-on crafts and challenges, there’s something for everyone to enjoy while learning about the past.
